text:
Priya: Quick sync - we need to finalize the MVP slimdown by Friday so eng can lock sprint plan. Proposal: move Tenant Insights (analytics) and Role-based Admin to v1. Keep SSO login, tenant onboarding, embeddings export, and the simplified prompt-store in MVP. Thoughts?

Devin: Agree with moving Insights and Admin to v1. One ask: can embeddings export be a delayed-garbage-collection approach instead of a streaming pipeline to shave infra work?

Sanjay: Yes, we can make export batch-first: nightly export job + streaming later. Pros: reduces realtime infra by ~30% and removes a canary dependency. Cons: longer time-to-data for customers. Work estimate: batch export = 3d infra + 1d QA.

Ellie: UX note: customers expect export to be discoverable. I'll wireframe a modal that explains "export pending" and ETA when batch mode used. Minimal copy will prevent support churn.

Marta: From product risk lens: removing Insights from MVP lowers visible value for pilot customers but reduces release risk. We should pick 2 anchor pilot tenants to validate before GA.

Priya: Anchor tenants idea: pick one internal partner + 1 external pilot. Use a short pilot checklist:
```
- onboarding flow verified end-to-end
- SSO tested (okta + azure)
- embeddings export completes within 24h
- prompt-store CRUD and restore tested
```

Devin: Two more considerations: observability probes for tail latency, and a cost cap default for early tenants. Suggest adding `mvp.latency-guard=400ms` for P95 search and `mvp.cost-cap=$500/mo` soft quota. Ops can override.

Sanjay: Agreed on guardrails. Probe plan: synthetic probes hitting long prompts every 10m, capture token cost and server-side traces. I'll slot that into SRE tasks. Estimate 4 days.

Ellie: I'll update the onboarding UX flows and produce a short support FAQ paragraph for batch export. ETA Wed noon.

Priya: Updated timeline suggestion: scope lock Fri EOD, codename 'slim-mvp' feature-freeze Tue 09:00, pilot start 2026-02-18, GA window 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-20 depending on pilot feedback. If any of the three guardrails (SSO, latency, export) fail in pilot, we hold GA and open rollback lane.

Marta: Action items: Priya -> publish slim-mvp cutboard and owners; Devin -> add cost cap + latency flag RFC; Sanjay -> probe + batch export infra plan; Ellie -> UX + FAQ; I'll coordinate pilot tenants and acceptance criteria. Ping when PRs are ready. :white_check_mark:

release-bot: Reminder: run `/freeze slim-mvp` before Tue 09:00 to lock merging.

Devin: I'll draft the flag docs and QA steps today.

Sanjay: I'll rebase infra tasks and mark autoshard deprioritized for this cycle to free the 4d needed.

Priya: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD Fri I'll mark scope frozen and send an announcement to stakeholders.
